mentions.name: Astroloot
mentions.description: Astroloot is a Diablo/Path of Exile-style action RPG set in space, with an endgame that culminates in pinnacle bosses; the final endgame pinnacle boss was completed in the version released last weekend.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I‘m working on Astroloot, think of a Diablo/PoE like ARPG but in space.

I‘ve just finished the final pinnacle boss of the endgame in the version released last weekend.
